title: encode_ruling result
description: Encode an official ruling's answer as the scenario's expect_ruling block (design D7), or verify another family's encoding. TERMINATING: the block is the expected value of a three-way comparison, so one family authors it (mode author) and the OTHER family, blind to the author's reasoning, must agree it encodes the answer (mode verify) -- design D5. The line is authored first and the block anchors on it (second pilot). Strict-mode compatible: every property is required, objects are closed, and the free-form `that:` map is carried as key/value_json pairs (tools.card_loop.interactions.packets.expect_ruling_block converts it to scenario YAML).

expect_ruling.description: author: the observables encoding the answer (required). verify: null.

at.description: Zero-based scenario step index whose pre-decision projection is checked (same as assert:). Use a later observation step to check an earlier action's resolved outcome.

key.description: A projection key the exam checker understands (exam::assertions::ASSERTION_KEYS). Security is a COUNT. legal_option_plays is a sorted multiset of legal Option card IDs in the actual Main decision actor's hand; request it only at that actor's Main boundary. Missing measurement fails, even when the expected list is empty. selection_can_decline is the live selecting actor's boolean capability to decline the current pending choice; request only at that actor's pending selection. Missing measurement never means false. selection_candidates is the exact multiset of offered card IDs at the live hand-selecting actor's prompt; physical copies stay duplicated. Unsupported prompt or missing measurement never means an empty list.

value_json.description: The expected value as JSON text: 3, "main", ["BT7-056"], or a field list.

agrees.description: verify: does the given block encode the publisher's answer -- no more, no less? author: null.

line_exercises_ruling.description: Does the scenario's line reach the situation the question describes? author: false (with expect_ruling null) sends the line back to its author; verify: false means no block on this line can encode the answer. null when not judged.

answer_quote.description: The words of the publisher's answer the observables encode (author), or that the block fails to encode (verify, when agrees is false).
